translations./teaching/prediction_prompt: The town is three times larger: water at the docks, gravel on Main Street, sand in the freight yard, plus two vehicles and three pedestrians. Which build can keep safe clearance through all of it?
translations./teaching/knowledge_card: An aggressive run can finish in 52 s and 1.2 Wh but leaves only 0.2 m clearance. Passing on Main Street needs 0.6 m: a 0.45 m body plus margin. A steady run trades 20 s for 0.7 m clearance and the safety badge. Pedestrian contact does not end the mission, but close passes still reduce safety.
